title: 珊瑚蜕境

selectedMaster.selection: 首轮粗看：单只白鹿横跨浅水石路并向右迈步，珊瑚门左枯右荣、低处旧头骨与远水可辨，蹄下石路薄水连续到底；未做统一复核。

generationRuns.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: opaque full-frame tarot card master for later holographic card production
Primary request: Create ONE original opaque full-frame 1024x1536 vertical Death tarot master, theme 珊瑚蜕境 / Coral Transformation. This is a serene coastal renewal scene with no disaster, violence, or gore.
Input images: Image 1 is an identity, symbolism, and painterly tarot-style reference only; create a new composition.
Subject: exactly ONE elegant white stag with large natural antlers walking credibly across a shallow-water stone path from LEFT toward RIGHT. All hooves make believable contact with wet stones or a very thin water layer; no other deer or living animals.
Scene/backdrop: a sculptural coral-stone arch is clearly divided: the LEFT side is pale, old, dry, and dormant coral; the RIGHT side carries fresh pink sea flowers and living soft coral. Calm deep-teal coastal water and a continuous shallow route recede behind the arch. Include exactly ONE small weathered animal skull low and subdued among the old left coral, not prominent.
Composition/framing: white stag crossing horizontally through the lower middle; coral arch above with unmistakable left-dormant/right-renewing contrast. The complete wet stone road and thin water under the hooves form one continuous grounded support reaching bottom bleed; distant water remains visually separate. Fine coral-pore tarot border.
Style/medium: luminous finely detailed hand-painted fantasy tarot illustration, elegant marine symbolism, opaque RGB full scene.
Lighting/mood: calm metamorphosis, release, tide-washed renewal.
Color palette: deep teal, coral white, soft pink, luminous white, restrained gold.
Constraints: exactly one white stag and one subtle skull; credible walking gait; clear old coral versus new sea flowers; full stone path and hoof contact visible.
Avoid: additional deer, fish or living animals, ghost deer, animal formed from skull, people, gore, blood, catastrophe, polluted sea, floating hooves, broken or tiny platform, text, title, letters, numbers, watermark, logo.
generationRuns.conclusion: Selected opaque master after first-pass coarse visual check; no transparent layers, assembly, or formal review.
